claims.claim_text: Ordinary text completion can stop the main loop without a general independent task judge. A separate verification-on-stop policy can suppress premature completion after code-like edits when fresh passing execution evidence is absent and ask the same agent for bounded follow-up verification. A missing config file is treated as current and inherits surface-aware `auto`; an existing versionless file is treated as legacy, and an unset or `auto` value is written as `false` when migration runs, as it is for affected older versioned installations. Thus “the default” depends on configuration origin and migration history.
